description: Nonrotating spherical Earth, surface arc distance, local pitch rate

provenance.maxThrustN: BE-4 manufacturer thrust scale, adopted as a one-engine reference design; not the engine specified by the problem
provenance.ispS: assumed effective descent value; sensitivity required
provenance.oxygenFuelRatio: assumed 3.5, guided by NASA 19950021840 Fig.2; not a measured sea-level engine ratio
provenance.axialCd: engineering closure assumption, not extracted NACA data
provenance.crossflowCd: engineering closure assumption guided by cylinder crossflow literature, not a digitized experimental fit
provenance.cpOffsetM: design uncertainty: +0.05 L toward nose; deliberately nonzero
provenance.propellantKg: trial inventory, not minimum or recommended answer
provenance.touchdown: chosen mission tolerances, not certified hardware limits
